title: SPORTING AND LYON AGREE A 5 MILLION EURO PRICE TAG ON FONSECA
description:
Five million euros. That is what Paulo Fonseca costs, according to the deal Sporting and Lyon have agreed.

Fonseca is fifty-three and reportedly open to the move. Sporting need someone: they are third, nine points behind Porto, and they lost at home to LASK in Europe. Rui Borges took over in December 2024 after Amorim left, and talks to end his contract have begun. Tiago Fernandes takes temporary charge before the Shakhtar match. Congratulations, and good luck.

The odd part? Sporting are third. Lyon are third too. Fonseca could swap third place in France for third place in Portugal. Same view, five million euros.

Is he worth that much to you, or is it a lot for a sideways step? Worth it or waste, comment below.
